fix.summary:
Repair the Recorder acceptance extractor at the native assistant-issuance seam. Current HEAD is incorrect: `src/recorder/extract.ts:61` requires `message.content.length === 1`, and an independent current-HEAD `AcceptanceCollector` counterexample with one lawful `thinking` block plus one direct package call returns `acceptance-invalid`. The persisted Issue #17 evidence also has a penultimate assistant row with two `thinking` blocks and one `ak_judge_output` call, followed by the matching successful final result; its child exited 0 while Recorder reported `acceptance-invalid`. The same real row carries ordinary current Pi AssistantMessage metadata, which the present synthetic-only exact-key check also rejects, so the regression must exercise the persisted shape rather than merely deleting the length check.

Admit a terminating issuance iff the direct assistant content array contains exactly one ToolCall total, that call names one package terminating tool, and every other content element is a lawful inert ThinkingContent. Validate each thinking block as a closed object with required `type:"thinking"` and string `thinking`, admitting only optional string `thinkingSignature` and optional boolean `redacted`. Validate the terminating call as a closed object with required `type:"toolCall"`, nonempty string `id`, package `name`, and record-valued `arguments`, admitting only optional string `thoughtSignature`. Optional means absent or correctly typed; null and extra fields are malformed. Preserve the #33 native AssistantMessage envelope contract and admit/validate its current persisted required metadata and current optional fields (including `responseModel`, `responseId`, `diagnostics`, `errorMessage`, and `rawStopReason`) rather than retaining the sparse synthetic-only message-key check.

Reject text, image, unknown/arbitrary objects, any non-package tool call, a second tool call (package or otherwise), malformed thinking/call objects, and multiple package calls as `acceptance-invalid` when attached to a candidate issuance. Nested package lookalikes remain non-issuances: alone they yield `acceptance-missing`, and as arbitrary siblings of a real issuance they invalidate it. Preserve matching/adjacency, rejected-attempt, unique-success, final-row/no-post-success, accepted-details validation, and all other #33 lifecycle laws. Thinking is discarded after structural admission: it must not enter Receipt details, audit observation, scanner input, manifest state, or any promoted evidence.

Add the smallest parser-level regression/mutation table covering zero and multiple valid thinking siblings, all admitted optional thinking/call fields, malformed optionals, forbidden sibling kinds, extra calls, and receipt non-projection. Add one sanitized representative persisted-shape regression through the real session-sealing/Recorder path, retaining the observed native envelope/content ordering and proving successful publication without thinking-derived state. Rebuild the tracked generated Recorder output with the repository build command and verify the source path and generated/cold-installed Recorder behavior; do not add another extractor, compatibility path, production hook, or unrelated Recorder redesign.

classes.name: Recorder native thinking-sibling issuance admission
classes.owner: `src/recorder/extract.ts` native `directIssuance` / `AcceptanceCollector` seam, with its existing Recorder integration tests and generated `dist/recorder/extract.js` output
classes.boundary: Direct Pi assistant issuance shape only: current native AssistantMessage fields, zero or more structurally valid inert ThinkingContent siblings, and exactly one structurally valid direct package terminating ToolCall; all accepted-result and post-success lifecycle laws remain owned by the existing #33 collector/finalizer.
classes.disposition: Sustained. Implement the bounded admission and validation repair, regress it at parser and real persisted Recorder seams, prove thinking is never promoted, rebuild generated Recorder artifacts, and preserve all listed rejection classes.

details.note: No owner policy choice is needed. Issue #33 already binds acceptance to current persisted Pi assistant fields and treats only typed package output as machine state; lawful reasoning siblings are transport/presentation content, not a second submission or evidence. HEAD is clean and default-based at `3fb482d`, but its current behavior rejects the reproduced lawful shape.
